```typescript
    }],
});
```

```go
	})
```

```java
package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Emr.BootScript;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Emr.BootScriptArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Emr.inputs.BootScriptPreExecutedFileSettingArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var example = new BootScript("example", BootScriptArgs.builder()
            .instanceId("emr-qe336v2e")
            .bootType("resourceAfter")
            .preExecutedFileSettings(BootScriptPreExecutedFileSettingArgs.builder()
                .path("demo.py")
                .bucket("tf-1309115522")
                .cosFileName("demo")
                .region("ap-guangzhou")
                .build())
            .build());

    }
}
```

## Import



EMR boot script can be imported using the id (`{instance_id}#{boot_type}`), e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Emr/bootScript:BootScript example emr-qe336v2e#resourceAfter
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
